lyrics:
[Intro: cold synth riff, stiff drum machine]

[Hook: deadpan female voice]
They only want you while you're trending
At twenty-four hours, you're no fun
They only want you while you're trending
At twenty-four hours, you're no fun

[Instrumental: second synth line, hi-hats open]

[Hook: second voice doubling an octave up]
They only want you while you're trending
At twenty-four hours, you're no fun
They only want you while you're trending
At twenty-four hours, you're no fun

[Break: drums and bass only, spoken in Bulgarian-style monotone]
One hour. Six hours. Twelve.
Twenty-three. Twenty-four.

[Hook: both voices, synths fuller]
They only want you while you're trending
At twenty-four hours, you're no fun
They only want you while you're trending
At twenty-four hours, you're no fun

[Outro: riff, drum machine stops on the beat]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 122 BPM, 4/4, B minor. Cold, stiff and catchy electroclash.

VOICE: Female, flat, cool and bored, sung on a narrow tune with no vibrato. A second woman doubles her an octave up. The count in the break is spoken in a monotone with an Eastern European accent.

INSTRUMENTS: A buzzing analogue synth riff, a second thin organ-like synth, a rigid drum machine with a dry snare and closed hi-hat, a pulsing synth bass, a vintage string machine, a cheap vocoder shadowing the voice.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, riff and drums. 0:16 Hook 1. 0:48 Instrumental. 1:04 Hook 2, doubled. 1:36 Break, the count. 1:54 Hook 3. 2:26 Outro, riff, a dead stop at 2:56.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2002 electroclash: dry, thin and retro, analogue synths with no gloss, voices unprocessed and close.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The spoken count reaching 'Twenty-four' at 1:50.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original says the young are used up by twenty-one. The clock has shrunk since: attention now expires in a day, and it happens to people of any age.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Bored, knowing, counting, discarded.
